name: Wendy Santiago
source: Pheraps the most ambigous and secretive of all the freshmen is Wendy at the Martenden House. Wendy has a great mind and devotes all her free time to her studies. She considers it her duty to patronize her friend Alice and keep her safe from unwanted acquitances with men.
